question: An ability says 'create a Tarmogoyf token' and doesn't say anything else about what the token is like -- no power, toughness, color, or abilities are given. What are that token's actual characteristics?

expected.shortAnswer: The token has the same characteristics as the card named Tarmogoyf, per its Oracle card.
expected.answer: Disa the Restless has the ability “Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Tarmogoyf token.” As that ability resolves, its controller creates a token with the same characteristics as the card named Tarmogoyf, as determined by the Oracle card reference.

whyHard: Players expect a bare 'create a [Name] token' instruction to produce a vanilla, characteristic-less token bearing only that name, or assume the game has no way to fill in the blanks. Instead the rules point at the named card's actual Oracle text and stats, so the token is a full functional copy of that printed card even though the ability never restates its power, toughness, or abilities.
